22. Sockets and Ports

A socket is an OS communication endpoint; TCP connections are distinguished by local and remote
addresses and ports plus protocol.
Socket එක communication endpoint එකක්. Server එක listen කරනවා; client එක connect කරනවා.
Accepted socket එJකන් Jදෙපැත්ත data exchange කරනවා.

Q: Can one listening port serve many clients?
